metadata.label: Human literature demo: 3 ligand-receptor interactions
metadata.scope: Engineering demonstration only; 3 manually selected interactions; not a complete ligand-receptor catalog; not official CellChatDB
metadata.attribution: Adapted and manually structured from Jin et al. (2021), Nature Communications 12:1088, doi:10.1038/s41467-021-21246-9, Figure 7 main text; CC BY 4.0. Interaction identifiers renamed.

jin2021_fig7.title: Inference and analysis of cell-cell communication using CellChat
jin2021_fig7.location: Human skin results, Figure 7d-f and accompanying main text

metadata.curation_notes: Independently transcribed from the human-skin results in the article main text. No official CellChatDB tables were copied. Complex subunits are preserved. Empty cofactor fields mean not specified by this demo, not biological absence. No guarantee of detectable communication in PBMC.
metadata.payload_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON of interactions/complexes/cofactors/gene_symbols; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)
